method: Confirmed src/09d_suite.js is unchanged since 623322c (git diff 623322c..HEAD touches only 04_shaders.js, 12_scene.js, 09b_py.js and 10_mono.js). Compared the w18 renders (ro/) with the head renders (rh/) for q02-q05 using the side-by-side cmp_*.png files, 2x crops of the console, ottoman, cap and aisle box (scratchpad zc_q02/q03/q05_*.png), and |dL|>8 diff masks (diff_*.png: q02 6.9 %, q03 20.3 %, q04 13.3 %, q05 12.8 %; mean dL -1.9 to -5.6). The diff mass is on the sidewall and window reveals, the window-console top and a few edge highlights. The suite surfaces are not in it. Box-mean RGB sampled on the same suite surfaces, old vs new: cap q05 190/187/172 -> 191/187/168, q04 194/192/179 -> 195/192/176, q02 180/178/168 -> 179/176/162; ottoman 148/139/130 unchanged; inner shell 92/84/79 unchanged; flank wood q03 75/73/73 unchanged; sheet 228/226/223 -> 229/226/222; leaf 109/103/99 -> 108/102/98. Sidewall q05 239/241/245 -> 206/211/225. The geometry was checked against the official pairs f_17301, f_17306, f_17304 and f_17313, with the in-flight OMAAT f5/f11/f13/f40/f60 values as cited in w17/w18. No new Playwright renders: the suite code is unchanged and the 1x renders show identical geometry. Lighting is noted below, not scored.

calibration.earlier_issue: w17a MEDIUM: cap joint box square and 2 mm proud, a black blade past the rounded shell end, near-black along its length
calibration.status: fixed, no regression. The code is unchanged since the w18 fix. In the head q02/q05 the cap still separates from the shell as a thin warm groove with no tab (zc_q02 / zc_q05).

calibration.earlier_issue: w15a MEDIUM: duvet head band square-edged / proud, z-fight dashes on the fold
calibration.status: fixed, no regression (q04 head: no dashes; band unchanged).

calibration.earlier_issue: w13b / w14a / w14b MEDIUM: wood flanks chestnut instead of espresso
calibration.status: fixed, no regression (q03 flank 75/73/72, R/B 1.04; q04 flank 122/120/120).

calibration.earlier_issue: w13b MEDIUM: duvet corner reads as an overlay (square edge, small flap)
calibration.status: fixed earlier (chamfered fold, rated fixed by w15-w18), unchanged in head q04. The low residue is the flat flap triangle, below.

calibration.earlier_issue: w17b LOW: cap joint corner tab
w17b LOW: wardrobe wood-panel split lines as black pen outline
w17b LOW: ottoman welt twice the f11 width
calibration.status: fixed (q03 head welt unchanged at its w18 weight).

calibration.earlier_issue: w18a/w18b LOW: cap groove a touch darker / harder than the soft f40 shadow
calibration.status: not fixed (not addressed). Still low and invisible at 930 px.

calibration.earlier_issue: w16-w18 LOW carried: loft bullnose / notch at the head band, aisle drape rail, flat grey flap triangle, footwell back lit, far-leaf moire, short flank grain
calibration.status: not fixed (not addressed). The lighting loop has not made any of them worse.
